⚖️ GM Instructions
Shape how your Game Master writes, judges, and illustrates this world.
🎚️Difficulty
How harsh the world is — how forgiving or merciless the Game Master is with consequences, combat, and the people you meet.

⚒️ These instructions will shape the world you're about to create — house rules and tone are woven into the starting location, factions, and your class.

📖Narration
The language the Game Master writes the story in — narration, dialogue, names and descriptions. Keep it on Auto to match whatever language you type in.
The story's rhythm over time — separate from scene length. Slow-Burn lets the world breathe (downtime, travel, quiet moments); Fast-Paced moves briskly between events and skips filler.
How much the GM leads the story — and how much it pushes back when your action goes off the intended path. Guided ends every scene with a clear hook and 1-3 concrete next steps; if you act against the current thread, the GM still resolves what you do but then gently steers you back toward the hook — detours are acknowledged, not derailed. Balanced offers occasional hooks but mostly follows you; off-path actions are honored in full and the story only sometimes pulls back to a thread. Sandbox never ignores or redirects you — nothing you do is overruled, every choice shapes the world, and no next step is pushed on you. (No mode lets you rewrite the world by fiat — impossible declarations always fail naturally.)
🎭Appearance
How freely can the GM change your hero's appearance over the story?
How freely can the GM change NPCs' appearance?
🧭NPCs
Named characters live their own lives — or stay in the background waiting for you.
Rooted keeps the world stable — characters rarely leave their location. Roaming lets NPCs travel, come and go, and show up in new places on their own.
How people you haven't met treat you by default.
How many named characters the world holds and how often new faces appear.
How well NPCs do their jobs — spotting lies, bargaining, fighting, keeping secrets.
Whether the people on your side hold firm under pressure.
⚔️Action & Consequences
How the GM resolves the actions you type (the ACT button). Balanced = fair resolution: reasonable actions succeed, risky or unreasonable ones can fail.
